name: Tanium Risk Assessment · Round 1
domainSummary: An endpoint-risk assessment and remediation-reporting pipeline evolved from an inherited proof of concept through two Python refactors and a later Go platform migration, with emphasis on collection, analysis efficiency, compact output, and maintainable product integration.
evidenceBoundary: Represent team-led evolution rather than solo authorship; do not expose scoring logic, customer data, or private implementation details.

researchSources.title: Project walkthrough: Tanium Risk Assessment
researchSources.use: Supported purpose, team leadership, refactor sequence, report-size reduction, and platform-migration boundary.

assets.name: Tanium Risk Assessment · Canonical Amplification
assets.controlledVariable: refine and amplify the accepted baseline geometry while preserving its defining silhouette; emphasize endpoint inventory collection
assets.thesis: The accepted identity is tested at its most resolved supporting-landmark scale. This version emphasizes endpoint inventory collection.

assets.name: Tanium Risk Assessment · Process Spine
assets.controlledVariable: recompose the landmark along a clear sequential service spine with repeated but unequal chambers; emphasize risk scoring and remediation planning
assets.thesis: A visible spatial sequence makes the project's process legible without arrows or diagrams. This version emphasizes risk scoring and remediation planning.

assets.name: Tanium Risk Assessment · Exchange Bridge
assets.controlledVariable: divide the major functions into unequal connected masses joined by one inhabited structural bridge; emphasize analysis efficiency
assets.thesis: A physical bridge tests whether handoff and exchange should dominate the identity. This version emphasizes analysis efficiency.

assets.name: Tanium Risk Assessment · Checkpoint Court
assets.controlledVariable: organize the building around a protected validation court with layered thresholds and one decisive exit; emphasize compact report representation
assets.thesis: A central court makes review, validation, or adjudication the primary metaphor. This version emphasizes compact report representation.

assets.name: Tanium Risk Assessment · Terraced Escalation
assets.controlledVariable: step the landmark upward through three or four connected terraces toward one compact focus; emphasize platform-oriented service migration
assets.thesis: Terraced hierarchy expresses staged progress and increasing commitment. This version emphasizes platform-oriented service migration.

assets.name: Tanium Risk Assessment · Modular Batch
assets.controlledVariable: build the landmark from repeatable unequal modules locked to one continuous service base; emphasize endpoint inventory collection
assets.thesis: Repeatable modules test batch, scale, and replaceability without detached pieces. This version emphasizes endpoint inventory collection.

assets.name: Tanium Risk Assessment · Guarded Recovery
assets.controlledVariable: place a protected core inside redundant connected routes with one visibly joined recovery annex; emphasize risk scoring and remediation planning
assets.thesis: Guardrails and recovery become architectural without implying an unverified implementation. This version emphasizes risk scoring and remediation planning.

assets.name: Tanium Risk Assessment · Asymmetric Landmark
assets.controlledVariable: concentrate height and mass off-center to create one singular project-scale skyline; emphasize analysis efficiency
assets.thesis: A deliberately asymmetric silhouette tests recognition at map scale. This version emphasizes analysis efficiency.

assets.name: Tanium Risk Assessment · Compact Deployment
assets.controlledVariable: compress the domain into the smallest dense, coherent project building that retains the accepted identity; emphasize compact report representation
assets.thesis: Compression tests which visual cues are essential rather than merely decorative. This version emphasizes compact report representation.

assets.name: Tanium Risk Assessment · Domain Synthesis
assets.controlledVariable: balance the strongest baseline, process, validation, exchange, and recovery cues in one resolved composition; emphasize platform-oriented service migration
assets.thesis: The synthesis tests a mature all-around project identity without becoming a city capital. This version emphasizes platform-oriented service migration.
